name.en: Delhi Arogya Nidhi (DAN) — Medical Financial Aid for BPL/NFSA Patients

bilingual_title.en: Delhi Arogya Nidhi (DAN) — Medical Financial Aid for BPL/NFSA Patients

eligibility_criteria.domicile_ncr_rule: Delhi (NCT) resident meeting residency rules; Haryana/UP NCR excluded.
eligibility_criteria.income_cap: BPL / NFSA / low-income norms [VERIFY LATEST NOTIFICATION]
eligibility_criteria.exclusions: Above income limit & non-Delhi NCT residents.

benefit.summary_hi: बीपीएल/एनएफएसए और कम आय वाले मरीजों को दिल्ली सरकारी अस्पतालों में गंभीर रोग उपचार हेतु वित्तीय सहायता।
benefit.summary_en: Medical financial aid for specified life-threatening treatments for low-income/BPL/NFSA patients at Delhi govt hospitals [VERIFY LATEST NOTIFICATION].

documents_required: NFSA/BPL Ration Card or Income Certificate

application_steps.offline: Submit via Hospital Medical Social Worker / DGHS Cell.
application_steps.facilitation_center: Delhi Govt Hospital Social Worker Desk / CFC

verification_note.hi: नोट ([VERIFY LATEST NOTIFICATION]): वर्तमान 2026–27 सक्रिय आवेदन विंडो, स्लैब व अंतिम नियम कृपया आधिकारिक सरकारी पोर्टल पर सत्यापित करें।
verification_note.en: Notice ([VERIFY LATEST NOTIFICATION]): Always verify active 2026–27 window, exact slab/amount, and current circular on the official portal before applying.

anti_dalal.csc_fee_note_hi: सरकारी CFC या CSC केंद्र पर केवल निर्धारित सेवा शुल्क (₹0–₹50) व पक्की रसीद लागू
anti_dalal.csc_fee_note_en: Nominal authorized CFC/CSC facilitation fee only (always take printed receipt)
anti_dalal.receipt_rule: Always collect your official Acknowledgement Slip & Reference Number after submission. Never pay without a printed receipt.
anti_dalal.middleman_warning: Never pay agents/middlemen promising guaranteed approval or faster clearance. Benefits are disbursed strictly via DBT / official portals.
